title: Stories and Experiences
summary: 叙事、综合时态、经历描述和连贯表达。
objectives: Set a scene and order past events

lessons.title: Set the Scene
lessons.subtitle: 交代背景与打断事件
grammar: 过去进行时表示背景；when + 一般过去时引出事件

vocabulary.example: Suddenly, the lights went out.
Meanwhile, Jo was looking for help.
The train had already left.

listening.title: Set the Scene
listening.transcript: We were eating outside when the lights went out. The owner brought candles, so we stayed at our table. The music stopped for a minute and then started again.

questions.q: What were they doing when the lights went out?

speaking.prompt: 用背景、打断事件和结果讲一段一分钟的小故事。
speaking.sample: We were eating outside when the lights went out. The owner brought candles, so we stayed.

reading.title: 交代背景与打断事件
reading.text: I was waiting for a bus when I saw a dog running alone. A woman was looking for it near the park. I pointed towards the station, and she found it there.

questions.q: Where did the woman find the dog?

writing.prompt: 写 90–110 词讲一件突发小事，写清当时在做什么。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（过去进行时表示背景；when + 一般过去时引出事件）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: When 从句用 went 表示打断背景的过去事件。
quiz.prompt: We were eating when the lights ___ out.
What does “suddenly” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: While We Were Waiting
lessons.subtitle: 描述同时进行的事
grammar: while 可连接同时进行的过去动作

vocabulary.example: Meanwhile, Jo was looking for help.
The train had already left.
It was my first experience of travelling alone.

listening.title: While We Were Waiting
listening.transcript: While I was checking the bus times, my sister was calling the hotel. We both stopped when the driver announced that the bus was leaving.

speaking.prompt: 讲清同一时间两个人在做的不同事情，然后交代发生了什么。
speaking.sample: While I was checking the times, my sister was calling the hotel. Then the driver called us.

reading.title: 描述同时进行的事
reading.text: While Nia was working on a level, Lee was testing the controls. At noon Lee found a problem. They fixed it together before the afternoon meeting.

writing.prompt: 写 90–110 词，用两个角色的不同动作讲一次共同解决问题的经历。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（while 可连接同时进行的过去动作）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: 两个同时进行的过去动作都可以用过去进行时。
quiz.prompt: While Nia was working, Lee ___ the controls.

quiz.explanation: meanwhile 在本课中指与此同时。
quiz.prompt: What does “meanwhile” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: What Happened Before That?
lessons.subtitle: 回溯先发生的过去事件
grammar: had + 过去分词表示过去某个时点之前的事

vocabulary.example: The train had already left.
Meanwhile, Jo was looking for help.
Suddenly, the lights went out.

listening.title: What Happened Before That?
listening.transcript: When we reached the platform, the train had already left. We’d read yesterday’s timetable by mistake. Luckily, there was another train in twenty minutes.

questions.q: What had they read by mistake?

speaking.prompt: 先说你发现了什么，再回溯之前发生的事，让听者明白因果。
speaking.sample: When I arrived, the train had already left. I’d read the wrong timetable.

reading.title: 回溯先发生的过去事件
reading.text: Lea arrived at the flat at nine. Her friend had left a key with the neighbour, so Lea could get in even though nobody was at home.

questions.q: Who had the key when Lea arrived?

writing.prompt: 写 95–115 词讲一次因早先疏忽造成的意外，写清两个事件的先后。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（had + 过去分词表示过去某个时点之前的事）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Had 后用过去分词 left。
quiz.prompt: The train had already ___ when we arrived.
What does “already” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Ask Me About the Trip
lessons.subtitle: 在经历与具体时间之间切换
grammar: 现在完成时问体验；一般过去时追问细节

vocabulary.example: It was my first experience of travelling alone.
The train had already left.
Meanwhile, Jo was looking for help.

listening.title: Ask Me About the Trip
listening.transcript: Have you ever taken a night train? Yes, I took one to Vienna in April. I shared a cabin with two people and slept for about five hours.

questions.q: How long did the speaker sleep?

speaking.prompt: 先问对方有没有坐过夜车，再追问时间、目的地和印象。
speaking.sample: Have you ever taken a night train? Where did you go, and what was it like?

reading.title: 在经历与具体时间之间切换
reading.text: Rita has joined several walking tours. Her favourite was in Porto last spring. The guide showed the group a small shop that sold old maps.

writing.prompt: 写一段 8–10 行采访，区分泛指的体验和有明确时间的旅行细节。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（现在完成时问体验；一般过去时追问细节）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Last year 给出已结束的具体时间，用一般过去时。
quiz.prompt: I ___ one in April last year.
What does “experience” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Although It Was Raining
lessons.subtitle: 讲清困难、转折和结果
grammar: although 引出让步；however 连接转折

vocabulary.example: We had an unexpected delay.
It was my first experience of travelling alone.
The train had already left.

listening.title: Although It Was Raining
listening.transcript: Although it was raining, we stayed for the outdoor concert. The crowd moved under the trees. The musicians kept playing, and we ended up staying until the last song.

questions.q: Why did people move under the trees?

speaking.prompt: 讲一个遇到困难却有好结果的故事，包含 although 或 however。
speaking.sample: Although it was raining, we stayed. We moved under the trees and enjoyed the music.

reading.title: 讲清困难、转折和结果
reading.text: The path looked easy on the map. However, part of it was closed after a storm. We took a longer path and arrived just before sunset.

writing.prompt: 写 95–115 词游记，包含原预期、障碍、行动和结局。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（although 引出让步；however 连接转折）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Although 表示尽管有这个困难，后面的事仍然发生。
quiz.prompt: ___ it was raining, we stayed for the concert.

quiz.explanation: unexpected 在本课中指意外的。
quiz.prompt: What does “unexpected” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Tell It in Your Own Words
lessons.subtitle: 把对话转述成完整故事

vocabulary.example: I reported what the guide said.
We had an unexpected delay.
It was my first experience of travelling alone.

listening.title: Tell It in Your Own Words
listening.transcript: The driver told us that the next bus would arrive in ten minutes. At the café, I told Ana about the delay and said we still had time to visit the park.

questions.q: Who gave the information about the next bus?

speaking.prompt: 用自己的话转述两个人说过的事，分别练习 said 和 told。
speaking.sample: The driver told us that the bus would arrive in ten minutes. I said we still had time.

reading.title: 把对话转述成完整故事
reading.text: Mo said that the room was ready. The receptionist told him that the key was at the desk. He messaged his sister with both details.

writing.prompt: 写 95–115 词转述一次服务人员和同伴的交流。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（said (that) ...；told + 人 + (that) ...）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Tell 可以直接接人作宾语。
quiz.prompt: The driver ___ us that the bus was late.

quiz.explanation: report 在本课中指转述；报告。
quiz.prompt: What does “report” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Weekly Challenge: Tell a Story Worth Sharing
lessons.subtitle: 讲并写一段有起伏的故事
grammar: 综合背景、先后、转折与转述

vocabulary.example: Finding the key was the turning point.
I reported what the guide said.
We had an unexpected delay.

listening.title: Weekly Challenge: Tell a Story Worth Sharing
listening.transcript: We were walking back to the guesthouse when we realised we’d lost our key. A shopkeeper said the tourist desk had a box for lost items. We checked, and someone had already handed it in.

questions.q: Where did they find the key?

speaking.prompt: 用两分钟讲一个遗失物品的故事，包含背景、先发生的事、一句转述和结局。
speaking.sample: We were walking back when we realised we’d lost our key. A shopkeeper told us about the tourist desk. Someone had already handed it in.

reading.title: 讲并写一段有起伏的故事
reading.text: Message from Jo: I found a blue bag by the station while I was waiting for a friend. I gave it to the ticket clerk. The clerk said the owner had already called to ask about it.

questions.q: Who received the bag from Jo?

writing.prompt: 写 110–135 词的故事，给出背景、问题、转折点和结果。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（综合背景、先后、转折与转述）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Had left 可回溯到叙事时点之前。
options: We had left the key on a bench.
quiz.answer: We had left the key on a bench.
quiz.prompt: Which clause gives an earlier cause?

quiz.explanation: turning point 在本课中指转折点。
quiz.prompt: What does “turning point” mean in this lesson?
